attempts.summary: Configured a hairpin routing chain (node3→node1→node2→node4) so TCP/23 traffic from node3 to node4 traverses node1 then node2. node1 (VyOS) accepts and logs the flow via a forward-filter rule; node2 (OPNsense) blocks and logs the same flow via a pf rule inserted ahead of the default-allow rule. Demonstrated one connection attempt and captured the correlated accept/block log pair for the identical packet (matching IP ID) on both nodes. Completed the mandatory per-node restart protocol on all 4 nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
